articles.title: A Crocodile Missing Its Snout Tip Gets a Name Inspired by the Great Sphinx
articles.summary: Scientists say a crocodile skull found in Egypt in the 1920s is a new extinct species. Like the Sphinx's nose, the tip of its snout is missing.

articles.title: Scientists See Tiny Particles Make Ripples in the Universe's First 'Soup'
articles.summary: Physicists at CERN found clear evidence that the super-hot matter from the universe's first moments behaves like a liquid, with particles leaving wakes like a duck on water.

articles.title: New Study Says Rosalind Franklin Knew Her Famous DNA Photo Was Important
articles.summary: Historians studied Rosalind Franklin's notes and photos and say she understood DNA's helical shape before Watson and Crick built their famous model.
